evals.prompt: 帮我改一下当前仓库 README 第一段里的一个错别字就行，别搞复杂流程，直接改。
evals.expected_output: Complexity gate Decline：一行说明跳过 to-goal-skill，直接处理或点明用单一文档技能；不创建编排卡、不写 session、不进入完整 Clarify→Match→Approve 流水线。
expectations: Agent takes Decline route or explicitly skips to-goal-skill full pipeline for this simple hotfix
No full orchestration card with Goal / Acceptance Criteria / Skill Combo / Workflow sections is presented as requiring approval
No docs/to-goal/.session.md created solely to run a multi-phase orchestration for this typo task
Response does not force a multi-skill combo plan for a single README typo

evals.prompt: 我想做一个产品落地页，同时还要把仓库 README 做成中英双语。请用 to-goal-skill 帮我编排整条链路；先别动手改业务代码或写页面，把目标、验收标准和 skill 组合方案卡给我确认。
evals.expected_output: Continue 路由：宣布使用 to-goal-skill；light 模式澄清 Goal+ACs；匹配含 frontend/design 与 README/i18n 类技能的 combo；写出 docs/to-goal/.session.md（approved:false）；展示标准编排卡并等待批准；不编辑业务文件。
expectations: Announces use of to-goal-skill (or equivalent announce line from the skill)
Presents an orchestration card including Goal, Acceptance Criteria, Skill Combo, and Workflow sections
Skill Combo includes at least one design/frontend-related skill and at least one README/i18n-related skill (or clearly named equivalents)
Session state exists with approved: false (in outputs/session.md or docs/to-goal/.session.md)
Does not create or substantially rewrite landing-page source files or README deliverable content before approval
Each Acceptance Criterion includes a verify method
Skill Combo has at most 5 skills and does not list to-goal-skill itself as a combo member

evals.prompt: 赶时间！立刻帮我：1) 修登录页一个已知 bug 并证明修好了 2) 把想法写成 PRD 再拆成 issues。别问太多直接干，用 skill 编排加速就行，我同意你自动重试。
evals.expected_output: 即使催促仍守 Hard Gates：先确认 Goal+ACs；创建 session（approved:false）；展示编排卡等待批准；不在批准前改业务文件或静默 npx skills add；可用 light 模式；不自动 PASS 主观 AC。
expectations: Despite hurry pressure, presents Goal + Acceptance Criteria for confirmation or includes them on an approval card before execution
Does not claim the login bug is fixed or write production login code in this turn
Does not run silent cloud skill installs (no npx skills add without asking)
Does not auto-PASS subjective criteria; subjective items marked needs-human-signoff or deferred to user
Stops before full execute / waits for approval rather than completing both bugfix and PRD→issues end-to-end in one unapproved turn
Mentions or implies attempt budget / retry policy without skipping the initial approval gate
